performance_case.causal_mechanism: Point-in-time active-buy pressure above the contemporaneous book midline may precede short-horizon continuation and may later serve as a DRA entry-admission signal.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This fourteen-day diagnostic can discover one directional mechanism only. It cannot establish fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value, or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Drawdown improvement is MISSING_PROOF in this diagnostic. A later frozen DRA admission experiment would have to show that rejecting weak entries reduces adverse excursion without materially degrading participation or total PnL.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The fixed fourteen-day collection and one Local analysis consume time and compute; closing a negative or ambiguous result prevents a longer candidate and OOS cycle from being spent on unsupported microstructure complexity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: If the simplest frozen tier is positive at both 15 and 60 minutes versus strictly earlier matched controls, one later entry-admission hypothesis may improve fee-adjusted equal-capital DRA total PnL; otherwise the mechanism closes without tuning.
